choices.drift: 4 populations per parameter combination with progressively shuffled mu ladders; round t uses population t mod 4
choices.reuse: one verification pool of size = budget drawn at round 1 from the flagged union and reused unchanged at every round, treated as a fresh sample
choices.poor_challenger: challengers drawn uniformly from the weakest half of the ladder
choices.allocation: minimax m_h proportional to q_h; matched flag volume gives N_C = N_I so m_C = m_I = budget/2
